inlines.v: ACCOUNT'ABLE, adjective 1. Liable to be called to account; answerable to a superior. Every man is accountable to God for his conduct. 2. Subject to pay, or make good, in case of loss. A sheriff is accountable as bailiff and receiver of goods. Accountable for, that may be explained. [Not elegant.]
